summary: Red Bull's early pace dominance sets up a fierce battle between Max Verstappen and the Ferrari duo, with George Russell and Charles Leclerc already flagging the Milton Keynes outfit as the weekend's team to beat. The heat-hazard conditions—the third such designation this season—will test tire degradation strategies and driver endurance, creating opportunities for tactical gambles from mid-grid challengers. A victory for Verstappen extends his championship cushion, while any slip-up gifts his rivals the opening they need to chip away at the points lead.
